name: How much does drain cleaning typically cost?

mainEntity.name: How much does drain cleaning typically cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of drain cleaning can vary based on the severity of the clog, the type of drain affected (sink, toilet, main sewer line), and the method required (snaking, hydro-jetting). Basic drain snaking for a minor clog might be less, while clearing a main sewer line blockage with hydro-jetting or requiring camera inspection to locate the issue will typically be more. It is best to get a specific quote after an assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Drain cleaning costs vary depending on the clog's severity, location, and the cleaning method needed. A specific quote is usually provided after an assessment.
